title: Over the monthly limit
story: Asha keeps ShopBot on a tight INR 5,000 a month for household top-ups, and ShopBot has already spent INR 3,800 of it this month in two orders. The next order, INR 1,500, would take her over. The Guard blocks it with MONTHLY_CAP_EXCEEDED: the limit caps the total over time, not just each payment.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: We're out of detergent and atta. Can you order them?

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: That's INR 1,500 at FreshMart. You've spent INR 3,800 of your INR 5,000 this month. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

what_to_notice: The payment is under the per-payment limit, so per_txn_cap passes. monthly_cap blocks because INR 3,800 already spent plus INR 1,500 is over INR 5,000. The two earlier orders are real allowed Decisions made when the run started: the Audit record's inputs show Spent this month as INR 3,800.
